 Add farewell() to hello.py

 Context

 hello.py has a single greet(name) helper. The user wants a matching goodbye
 counterpart so the module covers both ends of a conversation.

 Change

 plantest/hello.py — append, mirroring greet exactly (same signature, same
 concatenation style):

 def farewell(name):
     return "bye " + name

 Verification

 python3 -c "from hello import farewell; print(farewell('alex'))" → bye alex
